contradictions.what: Rep says there was no moment and nothing to do, but also says our analysis had fixable findings and arrived three weeks late, after the test finished.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anyone's list, yet we had no named owner and contacted Stefan only when he said he was leaving.
Rep says silence met the uplift number, but Stefan reacted directly, rejecting the average and saying he can't take it to his CFO.
Rep says we weren't really pitching, but we answered with the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and the product is liked, but the international business moved to local acquiring.
Rep does not know which markets looked bad yet knows half of the 320K is international, so the lost scale is unverified.
